docs.title: RAY-UI Documentation (development)
docs.text:
Ray tracing for synchrotron beamlines, developed at Helmholtz-Zentrum Berlin.

This describes the development build

These pages are built from the doc/ directory of the RAY-UI source repository, from the branch the nightly builds. They describe what the current development version does, which is not necessarily what a release does. A release publishes its own pages beside these, under …/ray-installers/doc/release/.

docs.title: Pages
docs.text:
• Looper preset format — the JSON a Looper preset is written in (*.rayloop.json), for the GUI's Load/Save and for the command line's looper validate|load|run.

More pages follow as they are prepared: the accelerator data file format, trace reproducibility, the radiometric quantities, and the physics notes behind the undulator and dipole sources.

docs.title: Where else to look
docs.text:
• Command line: rayui -h, or Help → Command Line Syntax in the application, lists every option of the background mode.
  • Installers and updates: https://hz-b.github.io/ray-installers/
  • Questions: Help → Support in the application opens a mail dialogue that reaches the developers.

docs.title: Looper Preset JSON Format (*.rayloop.json)
docs.text: This document describes the JSON format used by the Looper preset import/export in RAY-UI.

docs.title: Purpose
docs.text:
A Looper preset stores: - loop table columns (mapped to beamline parameters), - loop table rows (values + enabled state), - execution settings, - output/export settings.

The file is used by: - GUI: Load/Save Looper Preset, - CLI background mode: looper validate "<preset-file>", looper load "<preset-file>", looper run "<preset-file>".

docs.title: Required Schema and Version
docs.text:
• schema must be exactly "rayui.looper.preset"
  • version must be exactly 1

Any other schema/version is rejected.

docs.title: Full Example
docs.text:
{
  "schema": "rayui.looper.preset",
  "version": 1,
  "beamline": {
    "filePath": "/path/to/beamline.rml",
    "fileName": "beamline.rml"
  },
  "execution": {
    "inputMode": "table",
    "loopMode": "cartesian",
    "maxParallelJobs": 0
  },
  "columns": [
    {
      "elementName": "Monochromator",
      "parameterId": "photonEnergy",
      "unit": "eV"
    },
    {
      "elementName": "Undulator",
      "parameterId": "harmonic",
      "unit": ""
    }
  ],
  "rows": [
    {
      "enabled": true,
      "values": ["500", "1"]
    },
    {
      "enabled": false,
      "values": ["600", "3"]
    }
  ],
  "output": {
    "outputDir": "/tmp/ray-looper-out",
    "includeLooperColumns": true,
    "writeLoopDataCsv": true,
    "useParamValuesInFileNames": false,
    "saveScanRmlFiles": false,
    "exportEnabledKeys": ["RawRaysBeam", "FootprintAllRays"],
    "exportCsvSeparator": "\t",
    "exportCsvDecimalSeparator": ";"
  },
  "exporter": {
    "csvSeparator": "\t",
    "csvDecimalSeparator": ";",
    "enabledKeys": ["RawRaysBeam", "FootprintAllRays"]
  }
}

docs.title: Field Reference
docs.text:
Top-level fields: - schema (string, required): fixed value "rayui.looper.preset". - version (integer, required): fixed value 1. - beamline (object, optional): metadata. - execution (object, optional): looper execution settings. - columns (array, required, non-empty): parameter columns. - rows (array, required, non-empty): run rows. - output (object, optional): output settings. - exporter (object, optional): exporter settings.

beamline object: - filePath (string, optional) - fileName (string, optional)

execution object: - inputMode (string, optional): "table" or "parameter", defaults to "table" if invalid/missing. - loopMode (string, optional): "cartesian" or "parallel_zip_shortest", defaults to "cartesian" if invalid/missing. - maxParallelJobs (integer, optional): values < 0 are clamped to 0 (0 means auto/default behavior).

columns[] item: - elementName (string, required, non-empty) - parameterId (string, required, non-empty) - unit (string, optional)

rows[] item: - enabled (boolean, optional, default true) - values (array, required)

Validation rule: - each rows[i].values length must be exactly equal to columns.length.

Value conversion rule: - string/number/bool JSON values in rows[i].values are accepted and converted to strings internally.

output object: - outputDir (string, optional) - includeLooperColumns (boolean, optional, default true) - writeLoopDataCsv (boolean, optional, default true) - useParamValuesInFileNames (boolean, optional, default false) - saveScanRmlFiles (boolean, optional, default false): writes one scan_####.rml per scan into each scan folder. - exportEnabledKeys (array of strings, optional) - exportCsvSeparator (string, optional) - exportCsvDecimalSeparator (string, optional)

exporter object: - csvSeparator (string, optional) - csvDecimalSeparator (string, optional) - enabledKeys (array of strings, optional)

docs.title: Notes on output vs exporter
docs.text:
Both sections can contain exporter-related settings. - Newer preset writing includes exporter settings in output. - exporter is also supported for compatibility.

When both are present during loading: - values from exporter are applied after output and therefore take precedence.

docs.title: Validation in CLI
docs.text:
Use background mode:

Ray-UI -b
looper validate "<preset-file>"

looper validate checks JSON/schema/version and column/row consistency. If a beamline is loaded, it also checks whether referenced parameters exist.

To execute a preset in background mode:

Ray-UI -b
looper run "<preset-file>"
